### executive_summary
Technology executive who links regulated modernization release resilience with governed platform architecture, making operating discipline the basis for reliable innovation. From that operating base, SVP Engineering agentic AI platform control-plane architecture provides a coherent system for governed execution and platform direction. Software dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, exposes architecture dependency chains, and improves transformation visibility across enterprise complexity. In parallel, security gates, human override paths, and runtime proof-bundle lineage bring policy, escalation, and evidence into the platform lifecycle. That commercial operating model connects platform productization with IP-led revenue growth, margin expansion, and team scale, keeping business outcomes tied to engineering leadership. Future platform leadership can carry this combination of governed architecture, release resilience, and productized IP into disciplined enterprise growth.

### unify_narrative
Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to transform governed agentic AI architecture into an industrialized commercial engine, aligning platform direction, reusable IP, and disciplined enterprise deployment so regulated clients could adopt scalable capabilities through a repeatable operating model.

### unify_bullets
- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch and multi-agent orchestration contracts.
- bul_unify_002: Advanced CFO-aligned adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization by connecting enterprise workflow adoption with usage-based forecasting.
- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and exit disposition governance.
- bul_unify_005: Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data infrastructure, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.

### ibm_bullets
- bul_ibm_001: Led IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for financial-services modernization opportunities, delivering 20% joint revenue growth.
- bul_ibm_002: Built decision-support data models and BI views that connected modernization programs to executive operating decisions.
- bul_ibm_003: Led technical discovery and solution architecture mapping for enterprise financial-services pursuits.
- bul_ibm_004: Prioritized enterprise pursuits using solution-architecture feasibility reviews, account context, and buyer readiness, connecting technical validation to executive deal support.
- bul_ibm_005: Architected industry-specific AI, analytics, and cloud modernization reference architectures for financial-services decision support.

### ibm_narrative
Championed AWS alliance architecture at IBM, establishing decision-support discipline that connected modernization programs with executive operating decisions through a repeatable, executive-oriented operating model for complex enterprise pursuits.
